verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official MCP server, and a probe confirms its dedicated docs page. Coding agents can use it to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR and codebase-scan issues. Setup is documented for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, and a changelog entry adds subscription and seat management from the MCP client. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
